newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Daya Guna soars on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Daya Guna soars on debut.

text.p: Indonesian fisheries company PT Daya Guna Samudra soared on its debut on the Jakarta Stock Exchange on Thursday, brokers said.
It rose 10.25 percent to 2,125 rupiah from its offer price of 1,950 rupiah. Trading was active with 10.6 million shares changing hands by 0305 GMT.
"The opening price is quite impressive. It really attracted market attention," said one local broker.
But brokers said the upside seemed to be limited as many players were trading on a short-term basis, waiting for a huge public offering by Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) 1946.
"I think it (Daya Guna) could gain further than 2,150 rupiah because I heard the stock was traded in the grey market at a premium of 200 rupiah above the offering price," said one foreign broker.
PT Daya Guna Samudra floated 100 million shares at price of 1,950 rupiah per share with PT ING Barings Indonesia as a lead manager.
